richiami.difetto: Diesel vehicles may have had dual controls installed incorrectly due to a deviation from instruction manuals provided by the manufacturer.
richiami.rimedio: The heat proof mat in the engine bay of diesel vehicles must be checked to ensure it has been returned to its original position.
